title: sdks-unify-auth-retries-streaming-parity-v1.142.0
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: unify auth/retry behavior and streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs, fix parity gaps introduced in v1.141.x, and bump client versions to v1.142.0. This PR consolidates shared auth token refresh behavior, standardizes retry backoff and idempotency semantics, and improves streaming API ergonomics (consistent async iterators / event streaming helpers). Changes are intentionally small per repo but coordinated: - Python: expose RetryConfig, add AuthRefresh middleware, add streaming iterator that yields typed chunks. - TypeScript: add unified AuthClient that centralizes token refresh and injects into fetch/xhr adapters, fix event-stream parsing and types, and export StreamingReader helper. - Go: expose RetryPolicy struct, default backoff settings aligned with other SDKs, streaming helper that returns channel-based events. Checklist: [x] update auth token refresh flow across SDKs, [x] harmonize retry defaults and backoff, [x] add streaming ergonomics parity helpers, [x] unit + integration tests for each SDK, [x] update changelogs and release notes, [x] bump versions to v1.142.0. Testing notes: local integration runs against staging API, Python/TS test matrices passed on py3.10/3.11 and node16/18. Go tests passed with race detector. Backcompat: default retry/backoff tightened slightly but defaults are opt-out via RetryConfig/RetryPolicy. No breaking API surface intended; documented upgrade notes included in release notes. Related: ENG-1420 (SDK parity workstream), ENG-1488 (streaming ergonomics initiative), SUP-8792 (support ticket where discrepancy was reported).

notes: Coordinated release - make sure to publish SDKs in the order: go -> python -> typescript to avoid brief telemetry mismatches. Patch-level changes only; no user-facing breaking changes expected.
